title: A Voice Lost before Friday
story: The history group was due to present on Friday, and each student had prepared one section. On Thursday night Amir sent a message saying he had lost his voice and could not speak in class. Sofia offered to read his section as well as her own, but she asked the group to shorten the ending so the talk would still fit the time allowed. Denis moved the map earlier, because the notes explained the route of an old canal and the class needed that picture before the dates. They left the jokes out, since a written joke can fall flat when another person reads it aloud. In the morning Amir sat at the side and nodded when Sofia reached his title card. The teacher allowed the change once she heard why Amir could not speak. She later said the talk was clear and asked to see the notes he had prepared at home.

quiz.question: How did Sofia keep the group talk inside the time allowed?
options: She read his section too and asked for a shorter ending
She cancelled the talk and sent the teacher home
She moved the jokes to the start of the lesson
She asked Amir to shout his notes from the corridor
quiz.correctAnswer: She read his section too and asked for a shorter ending
quiz.explanation: Sofia offered to read his section as well as her own, and she asked the group to shorten the ending.
quiz.supportingSentence: Sofia offered to read his section as well as her own, but she asked the group to shorten the ending so the talk would still fit the time allowed.

quiz.question: Why did Denis move the map to an earlier point?
options: The class needed the canal picture before the dates

Amir wanted the jokes to come before any picture
The title card was too large for the final slide
quiz.correctAnswer: The class needed the canal picture before the dates
quiz.explanation: The notes explained an old canal route, and the class needed that picture before the dates.
quiz.supportingSentence: Denis moved the map earlier, because the notes explained the route of an old canal and the class needed that picture before the dates.

He refuses to look at the title card
quiz.correctAnswer: He stays involved by signalling when his part begins

Sofia wanted the talk to fill the whole day
quiz.correctAnswer: A joke can fail when a different person reads it out
quiz.explanation: They left the jokes out because a written joke can fall flat when another person reads it aloud.
quiz.supportingSentence: They left the jokes out, since a written joke can fall flat when another person reads it aloud.
